report.superseded.none: No facts were replaced by newer information in this scope.

report.suppressed.reason.partially_supported: only partially supported by the source
report.suppressed.reason.unjudgeable: could not be judged against the source

report.title: Findings report
report.toc.heading: Contents
report.trust.heading: Measured accuracy of this configuration
report.trust.notPublished: No published accuracy measurement exists for the model configuration that produced this report ({{configuration}}). The findings below are computed by the same verified process, but its error rate on this configuration has not been measured. Treat each finding as a pointer to the quoted passages, which can be checked by hand.
report.trust.published: The model configuration that produced this report was measured against a labelled evaluation corpus before release {{release}} (configuration {{configuration}}). The scores below are published and are reproduced here so findings can be weighed against measured accuracy rather than assumed accuracy.
report.trust.readingNote: Values are fractions between 0 and 1. A rate is always published with its denominator; the full metric set, including the unflattering ones, is in the machine-readable artifact.
report.verify.heading: Verifying this report
report.verify.intro: This report is signed by the private key of the instance that produced it. Anyone holding the machine-readable artifact (the JSON download of this same report) can verify that it is genuine and unaltered, using only standard tools and the published schema. This printed document is a rendering of that signed record and carries the same identifier, hash and signature.
report.verify.pdfNote: The full procedure, the schema, and a worked example are published in the repository under docs/findings-report-schema/.
report.verify.step1: 1. Canonicalize the payload: serialize the JSON artifact's "payload" object with keys sorted at every depth and no whitespace, UTF-8.
report.verify.step2: 2. Hash it with SHA-256 and compare the result with the payload hash above and with the one inside the artifact.
report.verify.step3: 3. Verify the ed25519 signature over the ASCII hex hash string, using the public key embedded in the artifact.
report.verify.step4: 4. Confirm the public key against the instance itself at the endpoint above, or against a copy obtained earlier.

report.provenance.heading: About this report
report.provenance.intro: This report was produced automatically from the documents listed in the coverage section. Every claim in it traces to a stored, verifiable record: each quoted passage names its document and its location, and the counts are computed from the same records the quoted passages come from.
report.provenance.noPreviousRun: No earlier report exists for this scope, so no comparison is shown. Changes over time appear from the second report onward.

report.superseded.intro: Chains recorded here: {{total}}. Each shows what was on record, what replaced it, when, and which document caused the change. This is the history a reviewer needs in order to understand why the current state is current.
report.superseded.none: No facts were replaced by newer information in this scope.
report.superseded.truncated: Only the {{limit}} most recent chains are shown here; the machine-readable artifact is bounded the same way and states it.

report.trust.heading: Measured accuracy of this configuration
report.trust.notPublished: No published accuracy measurement exists for the model configuration that produced this report ({{configuration}}). The findings below are computed by the same verified process, but its error rate on this configuration has not been measured. Treat each finding as a pointer to the quoted passages, which can be checked by hand.
report.trust.published: The model configuration that produced this report was measured against a labelled evaluation corpus before release {{release}} (configuration {{configuration}}). The scores below are published and are reproduced here so findings can be weighed against measured accuracy rather than assumed accuracy.
report.trust.readingNote: Values are fractions between 0 and 1. A rate is always published with its denominator; the full metric set, including the unflattering ones, is in the machine-readable artifact.
report.verify.heading: Verifying this report
report.verify.intro: This report is signed by the private key of the instance that produced it. Anyone holding the machine-readable artifact (the JSON download of this same report) can verify that it is genuine and unaltered, using only standard tools and the published schema. This printed document is a rendering of that signed record and carries the same identifier, hash and signature.
report.verify.pdfNote: The full procedure, the schema, and a worked example are published in the repository under docs/findings-report-schema/.
report.verify.step1: 1. Canonicalize the payload: serialize the JSON artifact's "payload" object with keys sorted at every depth and no whitespace, UTF-8.
report.verify.step2: 2. Hash it with SHA-256 and compare the result with the payload hash above and with the one inside the artifact.
report.verify.step3: 3. Verify the ed25519 signature over the ASCII hex hash string, using the public key embedded in the artifact.
report.verify.step4: 4. Confirm the public key against the instance itself at the endpoint above, or against a copy obtained earlier.
